# PDFLove.store — Online PDF & Image Utility Suite
> Fast, privacy-first browser-based PDF management, conversion, image processing, and document generation tools.

## Canonical Website
- Homepage: https://pdflove.store/
- Sitemap: https://pdflove.store/sitemap.xml
- Privacy Policy: https://pdflove.store/privacy
- Terms of Service: https://pdflove.store/terms
- About: https://pdflove.store/about
- Contact: https://pdflove.store/contact

## Processing Architecture & Privacy
- Local Browser Processing: Core PDF manipulation (merge, split, rotate, page extraction, watermarks, numbering, metadata, text extraction, page rasterization) and Canvas-based image operations run locally inside the user's browser using WebAssembly/JavaScript (pdf-lib, Mozilla PDF.js, SheetJS, Mammoth, HTML5 Canvas).
- Files processed via local browser tools are not permanently stored on external servers.
